objective: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

description: My experiments so far have not yielded any positive results, <name>. I can't help but hope that you can find a solution by searching for one of the pylons that I have heard exist.
Perhaps if we combine certain colors at them... but I get ahead of myself. Let's find them first!
<name>, search the western area of the crater; a pylon is said to be somewhere in that area.
completion: There are many hidden areas of the crater along the sides. Try exploring the winding paths if you can't think of anywhere else to look, <name>.
